name: Novum Xenium
tagline: A self-hosted agent workspace. A small desktop app to run it.

artifacts.label: Desktop app (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Docker with Compose is required. Open the app and select your existing Novum Xenium or NX-Odysseus checkout.

artifacts.label: Desktop app (Windows)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Requires Docker Desktop in Linux-container mode, Git and Microsoft Edge WebView2. Select your backend checkout in the app.
